About shader studio

  
The image the shader receives
Glyph alpha · one byte per pixelWaiting
White is glyph coverage. Black is empty. The caret, selection, syntax colors, and editor background are excluded. This is the captured text image sent to iChannel0; the evolving field is iChannel1. Life also receives a separate image of the glyphs’ syntax colors.
